data.exact_reserve_text: The Syndicate has applied a similar approach at the current year end to that applied at the previous year end in establishing the technical provisions for claims outstanding reserves and reinsurers' share thereof. Included within net claims incurred of GBP 20.2m (2018: GBP 65.5m) is a deterioration of GBP 1.2m (2018: improvement of GBP 4.6m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to unfavourable developments on a number of classes with partially offsetting favourable developments on the Pecuniary Loss and Casualty classes.
data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2019 were GBP 86.423m. The syndicate recorded prior-year adverse development (deterioration) of GBP 1.2m (net basis reported) principally driven by unfavourable developments across a number of classes, including increased attritional activity in the Motor Warranty book and an increase in the number of large losses reported in the 1861-led Casualty consortium; these adverse movements were partially offset by favourable development in certain classes (Pecuniary Loss and some Casualty items). No gross prior-year movement was separately disclosed, so the reported GBP 1.2m deterioration is taken from the net claims movement disclosure.
raw_causal_phrases: adverse actual vs expected claims experience in the period.
the Motor Warranty book within the Consumer Products portfolio experienced an increase in attritional claims activity
the 1861-led Casualty consortium was impacted by an increase in the number of large losses reported.

Included within net claims incurred of GBP 20.2m (2018: GBP 65.5m) is a deterioration of GBP 1.2m (2018: improvement of GBP 4.6m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to unfavourable developments on a number of classes with partially offsetting favourable developments on the Pecuniary Loss and Casualty classes.
data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year reserve movement was disclosed. The only quantified prior-year movement is stated as a GBP 1.2m deterioration within 'net claims incurred' (Note 9). Per instructions, the gross prior-year movement was not available and the net figure has been used as a fallback. The syndicate also undertook RITC activity historically (notably 2016 & Prior) which can distort development comparisons.
